relationships.statement: Nominal rates describe money payments; real rates adjust the comparison for inflation.

relationships.target: Concepts/Economics/Monetary Economics/Nominal and Real Interest Rates

relationships.statement: Policy-rate changes can affect money-market and bank lending rates.
